# Ignore dist folder
dist

node_modules---PORTS---

observation.command: cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---PORTS---"; for f in /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6; do [ -f "$f" ] && awk 'NR>1 && $4=="0A" {split($2,a,":"); printf "%d\n", ("0x" a[2])+0}' "$f"; done | sort -un
